name: River Village:  Fisherman's Joy
material: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; ink and color on silk
summary: The artist of this blue-green–style landscape, Zhao Mengfu, was a southerner, versed in all fields of literati pursuits, such as calligraphy and connoisseurship.
